description: Extract the tables from a document as typed JSON: send text (CSV, TSV, semicolon or pipe separated, Markdown tables or HTML), html, or a url to a web page or CSV file. Each table gets headers (multi-row headers joined, colspan and rowspan expanded), column types (number, percent, currency, date, boolean, string) and rows with parsed values. Deterministic, no model; up to 20 tables and 500 rows each. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

text.description: CSV, TSV, Markdown or HTML text containing tables

url.description: A public web page or CSV file, instead of text

name: extract_tables
title: Extract tables
